Cliente.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? A customer's product question, quote request, reservation, complaint or technical support request.

Lavoro.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? Colleagues coordinating internal tasks, meetings, projects or work schedules.

Personale.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? Private messages about family, friends, school, health, hobbies or leisure.

Opportunità.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? A personalized offer of a new job, paid assignment, partnership, investment or project collaboration.

Amministrazione.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? Invoices, receipts, taxes, payroll, payments, reimbursements or official paperwork.

Spedizioni.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? Delivery, tracking, pickup, return or customs clearance of an actual parcel.

Pubblicità.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? Mass advertising, promotional offers, public newsletters or selling a course or subscription.

Notifiche.instructions: Is the main purpose of this email described by this category? Automated account-security, password, backup, monitoring or service-status messages.

decision_rule: argmax of the eight independent yes probabilities; not a normalized class distribution
